WHERE (toLower(p.name) = toLower("John Alexander Thain") OR any(a IN p.aliases WHERE toLower(a) = toLower("John Alexander Thain")))
  AND type(r) CONTAINS "Board"
RETURN DISTINCT c.name AS company
